recognize_zh: 視野中四顆嗜中性球（含兩顆帶狀核）的細胞質佈滿粗大、深紫黑色的顆粒，比正常嗜中性球的淡粉紅細顆粒明顯粗且深，即中毒性顆粒（toxic granulation），符合敗血症等感染狀態。
features: Four neutrophils, two segmented and two band/early segmented forms (left shift)
Cytoplasm densely filled with coarse, dark purple-black granules replacing the normal fine pink granulation
Nuclear chromatin clumped with normal lobulation; no hypersegmentation
No definite Döhle bodies or cytoplasmic vacuoles evident in this field
Background red cells show rouleaux-like stacking in thicker areas
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several neutrophils, including band forms, with cytoplasm filled by coarse, dark purple azurophilic granules consistent with toxic granulation. Nuclear segmentation is appropriate for band and segmented forms, and definite Döhle bodies or toxic vacuolation are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with toxic granulation with left shift, a reactive change seen in sepsis and other severe inflammatory states or G-CSF therapy.

ddx.vs: Alder-Reilly granules are large and dark in all neutrophils, as well as in lymphocytes and monocytes, and persist without infection.
Chédiak-Higashi neutrophils contain a few giant, irregular pink-grey granules rather than many uniformly coarse fine dark granules.
Overstaining darkens granules in all cells including the background and red cells, whereas toxic granulation varies from cell to cell.
Basophil granules are larger, blue-black and overlie and obscure the nucleus.
